findings.summary: font-size: ${t.text.sm} produces invalid CSS (double font-size declaration)
findings.detail: In the Styled.SubjectPreview component added by this diff, line 307 uses `font-size: ${t.text.sm};`. The theme's `t.text.sm` is a `css` template literal that already includes the full `font-size: 0.875rem;` property declaration (confirmed in app/javascript/ats/styles/theme.ts line 94-96). Using it inside a `font-size:` property produces invalid CSS like `font-size: font-size: 0.875rem;`. This is the exact failure pattern documented in the pipeline CLAUDE.md (Known Failure Pattern #1, motivated by this same feature's earlier review rounds). The fix is to use `${t.text.sm};` standalone instead of `font-size: ${t.text.sm};`.
findings.spec_ref: No direct spec requirement for styling; this is a CSS correctness bug in the template selection modal's subject preview display.
